checks.evidence: Test 1 covers receipt of PBD data and computing a restriction, but never checks that the permitted speed equals the computed value (V1) within the restriction. It also lacks level 1/2, ceiling speed monitoring, National Values and passing the start location.

Test 3 changes a generic input (e.g., current speed) and expects recomputation. It does not use new National Values changing the emergency brake confidence level, and it does not check that the permitted speed changes to V2 different from V1 within the restriction area.
